    IssuedWakanda battle suyaBring me Thanos! Peanut spiced beef skewers, grilled hotHow to make it80g roasted peanuts, ground1 tsp smoked paprika1 tsp ground ginger1 tsp chilli flakes1 tsp salt500g beef rump, thinly sliced1 red onion, sliced2 tomatoes, slicedGrind the peanuts with the paprika, ginger, chilli flakes and salt.Coat the beef in the spice and thread onto skewers.Grill hot until charred.Serve with sliced red onion and tomato.School bus ham and cheese pizza scrollsStan Lee drives the school bus. Ham, cheddar and oregano scrollsHow to make it60g cold butter, cubed400g self-raising flour250ml milk3 tbsp tomato paste150g ham, chopped150g cheddar, grated1 tsp dried oreganoRub the butter into the flour, then mix in the milk to a soft dough.Roll out to a 30 x 40cm rectangle and spread with tomato paste.Scatter with ham, cheddar and oregano, then roll up from the long side.Cut into 12 slices and lay cut side up in a lined tin.Bake at 210°C until golden.Crew onlyThanos's farm stewPumpkin and chickpea stew with flatbread, for the sunrise on Thanos's farmHow to make it1 brown onion, chopped2 tsp ground cumin2 tbsp olive oil800g butternut pumpkin, diced2 tins of chickpeas, drained400g tin crushed tomatoes500ml water100g baby spinach4 flatbreadsSoften the onion with the cumin in the oil.Add the pumpkin, chickpeas, tomatoes and water and simmer until the pumpkin is tender.Stir in the spinach until wilted.Warm the flatbreads and serve alongside.Wakandan chicken with jollof and plantainThighs in ginger, garlic and chilli over coals, smoky tomato rice, fried plantain, hold the lineHow to make itNot on tonight's cookChicken thighs marinated in ginger, garlic, chilli and lime, grilled over coals, with smoky tomato jollof rice and fried sweet plantain.Marinate 1kg chicken thighs in 2 tbsp grated ginger, 3 garlic cloves, 1 chopped chilli, the juice of 2 limes and oil for 1 hour.Fry 1 onion, add 2 tbsp tomato paste, 400g crushed tomatoes, 1 tsp smoked paprika and 1 tsp curry powder, then 300g rice and 500ml stock.Cover and cook gently 25 minutes.Grill the chicken 6 minutes a side.Fry 2 sliced ripe plantains in oil until caramelised.RationedInfinity Stone fruit jelly cupsSix colours layered in cups. All six, one snapHow to make it3 packets of jelly crystals (red, orange, green)6 tsp gelatine powder750ml apple juice250ml purple grape juice1 tbsp dried butterfly pea flowers250ml boiling water125g raspberries1 mango, diced150g green grapes1 can pineapple pieces, drained200g purple grapes125g blueberries200ml cream1 tsp vanilla extractMake up the red, orange and green jellies as the packets say.Steep the pea flowers in the boiling water, strain, then dissolve some gelatine in each of the apple, grape and blue liquids.Divide the fruit between glasses by colour: raspberries for the red, diced mango and drained pineapple for the orange, green grapes for the green, purple grapes for the purple and blueberries for the blue. Pour the matching jelly over each.Chill until set, at least 4 hours.Whip the cream with the vanilla and spoon on top to serve.LoggedThe rabbit's pineapple ginger coolerPineapple, ginger and lime. Thor says the rabbit is the smart oneHow to make it1 pineapple1 5cm piece ginger, peeled2 limes3 tbsp honey500ml cold water200ml soda water1 bunch mint1 bag icePeel and chop the pineapple, then blend with the ginger, lime juice, honey and water until smooth.Strain through a sieve, pressing on the pulp.Chill for an hour.Pour into glasses of ice, top with soda water and garnish with mint and a pineapple wedge.
